instruction: Befriend on Venmo anyone I have sent or received money from this month and unfriend everyone else.
notes: Single-app Venmo task. The agent must (1) list this month's transactions (show_transactions with min_created_at=2023-05-01T00:00:00, both directions, paginate if needed) to collect counterpart emails, (2) list current friends (search_friends with no query, paginate if needed), then add_friend for every this-month counterpart not already a friend and remove_friend for every current friend with no this-month transaction; people who are both transacted-with and already friends are left untouched. Because the actual users are unknown before runtime, representative placeholder persons are declared as domain constants (recent-payee-1/2: transacted, not friends -> add; stale-friend-1: friend, no transaction -> remove; kept-friend-1: friend with transaction -> keep) so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can mirror the ground goal literals without quantification. (transacted-this-month)/(is-friend) describe database state; knowledge gating is via (transactions-reviewed) and (friends-reviewed), which add/remove actions require. At runtime the add/remove steps are repeated once per actual user in each set; the placeholder counts (2 adds, 1 remove) match the 8-call reference length. complete_task takes no answer.
